_meta.note: A SECOND process restores the session by session/load: the conversation is replayed as user_message_chunk and tool_call frames before the answer, which carries configOptions and modes; the next prompt answers from the restored history. Then a /allow-all on prompt, and session/close. A third process loading the same session sees allow_all on (measured separately), which is why Crew writes allow_all off after every load. Reductions: session and tool-call ids replaced with fixed synthetic values; the recording host's scratch paths replaced with /work/copilot-probe; available_commands_update, session_info_update and agent_thought_chunk frames dropped; authMethods' terminal-auth command normalized to copilot.
